mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 51 degrees with overcast skies near Fireman Park under a New Moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will drop to 43 degrees, with rain predicted overnight.

The City of Verona is busy with the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes updates to water mains and storm sewers between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, with phase two construction now underway.
We have a busy schedule for trivia lovers today with events at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, you can look forward to more trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a man who was subsequently arrested for his first offence of O W I.
You can grab a scoop of Chocolate Heath Crunch today until the store closes at 10:00 PM.
